newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds firm after bond auction.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds firm after bond auction.

text.p: Portuguese bonds were buoyant after today's 10-year bond auction came out in line with expectations, but volume was thin, dealers said.
"Futures are being pushed along by peripherals, but the rise of 10-year bonds is more restrained with the spread against Bunds holding at around 90 basis points," a fixed income analyst said.
A dealer said: "I don't see 10-year bonds rising much more, because there is not enough demand from institutional investors."
The escudo traded in a narrow range against the mark during the morning and stood at 100.52/54 per mark at 1123 GMT.
